posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I'm very excited about this too, and will definitely be buying the app ASAP.

My concern from the video is that the background looks very busy and distracting against the colourful cards and makes it more difficult to see and recognise the cards themselves. Obviously you've spent a lot of time and effort on it, but honestly I'd prefer a plain black background which would look more like a comic book anyway...

How about an option to toggle the background on and off? I'm sure that would be appreciated by people with colourblindness too.

I'm sure it was confirmed before that we'll be able to mute the music, but I was reminded about it so I thought I'd mention it again. The music is great, fantastic job there, but by 90 seconds into the video I was desperate to turn the music off.

It's all shaping up nicely though, and I particularly like the "don't care" option when assigning damage. That's a nice touch.
